Continued e5aeae2c on work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007 with opt-in single-bank decoder integration. ProfileDecodePolicy.trialReferences binds <=8 explicit points, one/two frozen scored reference indices, and compact full-jet storage. The decoder captures routing before responses; public corrected readout stays within those scored indices, so it cannot spend a third reference. No second grid bank is built. Provenance binds coordinates, routing, storage and exact continuous-factor scope. ML/condition routes reject the option before preparation; original-equation certification still refuses.

The frozen default-budget boundary-shape diagnostic retains all 16 attempts (eight N=30, eight N=300). All refuse CurvatureNotPositive at reference 6; none emit amplitudes or perform continuous factors/readout. No retuning follows measurement. This is a decoder counterexample, not a new accuracy pass. Gaussian expanded-budget integration exercises charged continuous factors and successful corrected readout; it is only an explicit diagnostic control.

Final gates: 720 fit JVM / 662 fit JS; 13 affected laws per platform; repository-wide compilation passes, with no compiler warnings. Final routing follow-up: 53 fit tests per platform. Prior 255/256 fixed-shape confirmation and 231.89 MiB bank/worker retained graph remain preserved but do not qualify decoded accuracy or the complete prepared owner. Peak live memory, original-family certificate, calibration and B0 throughput remain open. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-reference-decode-20261008/README.md, diagnostic.json, frozen protocol and hash verifier. No publication or epic closure.
